evidence: Implemented shared WebView provider cookie backup/restore: ProviderWebSessionCookieBackupStore stores per-provider cookie headers from ProviderWebSessionClearPolicy.cookieUrls after trusted payload, restores before hidden WebView refresh, clears on disconnect. Target tests passed and debug APK installed. Post-install smoke had no crash; GLM fallback cooldown logged skip. Current emulator shared WebView cookies were already empty before backup existed, so non-GLM providers still reached login pages until user reauth creates backup.
message: This moves package-replace session retention toward the requested state without global cookie deletion or per-provider WebView profile changes. Full 120m monitor requires re-login/one successful collection to seed backups.
